profile.headline: Software Engineer at Optum (formerly Rally Health)
profile.summary:
Where do logic, creativity, and efficiency intersect?

That question was the driving force for my decision to switch careers from math to technology. As a software engineer, my goal is to find a nice balance between utilizing my left and right brain. My high school education in fine arts helped me to discover my creative side and think and express myself more creatively. My college education in math deepened my desire to problem-solve and helped me gain an appreciation for logic, order, noticing patterns, and developing systems. While in college, I also developed an interest in industrial engineering because I like the idea of trying to do more with less -- whether that’s less time, less money, less resources -- and do so efficiently. I believe that software engineering allows me to bring all of those things together.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code according to required specifications and designs while adhering to coding standards and best practices.
Write and update unit tests for impacted components.
Maintain documentation for engineering processes and coding standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to performance and application bugs.
Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices and promote knowledge sharing across the team.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React Native · JavaScript · Software Engineering Practices · Software Development

positions.title: Finalist
positions.description: YearOne recruits self-taught coders and engineering bootcamp graduates with a rigorous 2-step technical interview. Once finalists are chosen to join the program, they are coached and mentored throughout their job search and given opportunities to apply directly to partner companies that are hiring non-traditional software engineers. Upon placement with a partner company, finalists receive 6 months of on-the-job mentorship to help support them in the early days of their new career.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Simultaneously gained familiarity with an Angular-based web project and a React Native mobile project.
Assisted more senior engineers with transitioning the web project from Angular to React.
Built a mobile-responsive modal and banner to convert mobile website users to mobile app users.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer in Training
positions.description: A 17-week software engineering program centered on full-stack JavaScript development, including Node.js, Express, Sequelize ORM for PostgreSQL databases, React and Redux; along with HTML & CSS, and CS fundamentals.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Node.js · React.js · Redux.js · Sequelize.js · JavaScript · HTML5 · Express.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Managed and processed payroll for upwards of 60 union and salaried employees to ensure deadlines were met.
Processed accounts payable invoices, purchase orders, and company credit card statements.
Responsible for technical support for all staff and office machines, including laptops, desktops, and printers.
Directed new hire pre-employment and on-boarding processes to include training on company policies and standards.
Completed on-boarding paperwork and maintained employee personnel files.
Collected, inputted, and analyzed data for operational statistics used for business decisions by upper management.

positions.title: Temporary Office Assistant
positions.description:
Hired through the Robert Half Company.

Assisted office manager with administrative tasks as assigned.
Scheduled meetings, organized catering, and assisted with event planning.
Processed incoming and outgoing mail.
Conducted internal audit of hours of service and timekeeping records.

positions.title: Student Manager, Assistant Supervisor
positions.description:
Supervised 10 employees and trained new hires on business procedures and policies.
Oversaw store operations of retail food and movie rental location. Maintained inventory of store supplies while providing excellent customer service.
